description: PAINTSDECOR offers decorative wall and ceiling products for residential and commercial interiors, including faux tin ceiling tiles and stylish surface solutions. Affiliates earn a 15% commission on eligible, approved referral sales, with 30-day referral tracking. We welcome interior design creators, DIY and renovation influencers, contractors, bloggers, and home-improvement publishers. Promote PAINTSDECOR through original reviews, installation guides, project inspiration, videos, and social content. Visit www.paintsdecor.com. For affiliate support, contact paintsdecor@vip.126.com.
payout_period: Approved commissions are paid monthly after a 30-day review period, once the affiliate balance reaches the US$50 minimum payout threshold. Payment timing may vary due to weekends, holidays, processing, or account verification.

PAINTSDECOR Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Effective date: August 24, 2026

These Terms & Conditions govern participation in the PAINTSDECOR Affiliate Program (the “Program”). PAINTSDECOR is a brand operated by 温州市品达科装饰材料有限公司 (English translation for identification purposes: Wenzhou Pindake Decorative Material Co., Ltd.), the operator of https://www.paintsdecor.com (“PAINTSDECOR,” “we,” “us,” or “our”), offers approved affiliates (“Affiliate,” “you,” or “your”) the opportunity to earn commissions by referring eligible customers. By applying for or participating in the Program, you agree to these Terms & Conditions and our Affiliate Privacy Policy.

1. Eligibility, Application and Approval

You must be at least 18 years old and legally able to enter into a binding agreement. All application information must be complete, accurate and kept current. We may approve or reject any application at our reasonable discretion. Approval is personal to the applicant and may not be transferred without our written permission.

2. Affiliate Links, Coupons and Attribution

Approved Affiliates may receive unique tracking links and, where assigned, coupon codes. You may only promote coupon codes that PAINTSDECOR has specifically assigned or approved for you. A customer using both a link and a coupon does not generate duplicate commissions. Referral attribution is determined by PAINTSDECOR’s current tracking and attribution settings in UpPromote. Commissions are payable only for orders successfully recorded, validated and approved in the Affiliate Dashboard. If tracking is prevented by cookie settings, deletion, browser restrictions, technical limitations or an incorrectly used link or code, a commission may not be recorded.

3. Commission Calculation

Your current commission rate and any product-specific or campaign-specific rate are shown in your Affiliate Dashboard. The Dashboard rate applies prospectively and may be changed by PAINTSDECOR with notice. A commission is calculated on the eligible net merchandise amount actually paid by the customer, after discounts, credits, gift cards and refunds. Taxes, duties, shipping, shipping tax, tips, payment fees and other non-product charges are excluded. Product-specific exclusions or special rates shown in the Dashboard override the general rate.

4. Validation, Payment Schedule and Minimum Threshold

Referral commissions remain pending for a minimum 30-day review period. PAINTSDECOR may extend review where an order is still within a return period, under investigation or not fully completed. Approved balances of at least US$50 are paid on or around the 15th day of each month for commissions cleared before that payment cycle. Balances below US$50 roll forward to the next cycle.

PAINTSDECOR will bear ordinary payment-processing and currency-conversion fees charged to send an approved commission. Affiliates remain responsible for their own tax registrations, filings and reporting. PAINTSDECOR will bear, withhold or remit taxes only where applicable law requires PAINTSDECOR to do so. Affiliates must provide accurate payment and tax information when requested.

No commission is payable on canceled, returned, refunded, charged-back, fraudulent, duplicate, test, unpaid, self-referred or otherwise ineligible orders. PAINTSDECOR may reverse or offset commissions connected with such orders.

5. Prohibited Conduct

You must not:

  • purchase through your own Affiliate link or coupon, or arrange purchases primarily to generate commission;
  • use cookie stuffing, forced clicks, bots, automated traffic, fake traffic, adware, malware or misleading redirects;
  • create duplicate accounts, split or manipulate orders, fabricate transactions or interfere with attribution;
  • publish, submit, leak or distribute an unapproved coupon code, including on coupon, deal or cashback websites;
  • send spam, unsolicited bulk email, automated direct messages or deceptive advertising;
  • make false, exaggerated or unsubstantiated statements about PAINTSDECOR products, materials, performance, fire ratings, installation, warranties or availability; or
  • violate any law, platform rule or third-party right.

6. Brand Protection and Advertising Rules

Without PAINTSDECOR’s prior written approval, you may not bid on or purchase paid-search keywords containing PAINTSDECOR, misspellings, variations, product names or related branded terms; use PAINTSDECOR in domains, subdomains, social-media handles, marketplace seller names or app names; impersonate PAINTSDECOR, its website, employees, representatives or an exclusive dealer; or create advertising that could reasonably appear to be an official PAINTSDECOR advertisement.

Logos, product images, videos and other brand materials may be used only as supplied or expressly approved by PAINTSDECOR. They may not be materially altered, sublicensed or used for unrelated products. All goodwill arising from their use belongs to PAINTSDECOR. Permission ends immediately when your Program participation ends.

7. Affiliate Disclosure

You must clearly and conspicuously disclose your material relationship with PAINTSDECOR wherever you promote us, including posts, videos, reviews, livestreams and emails. The disclosure must be easy to notice and understand and placed close to the endorsement or link, not hidden only in a profile, footer or group of hashtags. An acceptable example is: “I may earn a commission from purchases made through this link.” You must comply with the FTC Endorsement Guides and all other applicable advertising and consumer-protection rules.

8. Marketing Materials and Content

PAINTSDECOR may provide approved banners, logos, product images, links or promotional copy through the Affiliate Dashboard. You are responsible for your own content and must promptly correct or remove content at our request if it is inaccurate, outdated, unlawful or inconsistent with these Terms.

9. Monitoring, Suspension and Termination

PAINTSDECOR may review traffic sources and referral orders and may temporarily suspend tracking or payment while investigating unusual activity. We may immediately suspend or terminate an Affiliate for fraud, serious misconduct, brand misuse, legal violations or material breach. Invalid or non-compliant commissions may be rejected, reversed or offset.

An Affiliate may leave the Program by contacting paintsdecor@vip.126.com. Valid commissions approved before termination will be paid on the next normal payment date. If a final approved balance is below US$50, PAINTSDECOR will pay it within 60 days, subject to applicable law and successful payment verification.

10. Program and Term Changes

PAINTSDECOR may update the Program, commission rates or these Terms. Material changes will be communicated through the Affiliate Dashboard, email or the registration page and will apply prospectively from the stated effective date. Continued participation after that date constitutes acceptance. Changes do not reduce commissions already approved before the change.

11. Independent Relationship and Limitation

You participate as an independent contractor, not as an employee, agent, joint venturer, franchisee or legal representative of PAINTSDECOR. You have no authority to bind PAINTSDECOR. To the extent permitted by law, PAINTSDECOR is not liable for indirect, incidental or consequential losses arising from Program participation, tracking interruptions or third-party platforms.

12. Contact

Questions about the Program or these Terms may be sent to paintsdecor@vip.126.com.
